title: M4: A collection exports as one folder: its kept clips as clip files and its short sounds as a drum rack
description:
## Purpose

As a crate digger, I want a collection of kept clips (the curation loop's crates) exported as one folder, with a clip file per kept clip in collection order and a drum rack of its short sounds, so that a digging session turns into a browsable set of loops and a playable kit in the DAW.

`apricity export --clips --collection <name> --library <dir> [-o <folder>] [--force]`

## Words

The storage model still says `Crate`/`CrateItem`; design/vocabulary.md plans the rename to **Collection** (not yet on the board as a task). The command and docs say "collection" from the start; the code reads `Crate` until the rename lands and follows it then (no alias kept, per the no-backward-compatibility rule).

## Scope

- `<out>/<collection>/NN <file name>.alc` per item, in the collection's order (`NN` = position, 01, 02, ...), named by the shared rule (apricitus-998976), written by the shared `.alc` writer (apricitus-007386).
- `<out>/<collection>/<collection>.adg`: a drum rack whose pads are the items no longer than one bar (proposal; owner decides), in collection order from C1, level-matched together the way a drum kit's pads are, built by M1's rack writer.
- Only from a library (collections are stored there).

## Out of scope

Saved kits (planned); editing collections; a collection as an `.apr` score (design/curation.md's `curation crates`), which stays as it is.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C[library: collection items in order] --> F[NN name.alc per item]
  C --> P[items up to 1 bar] --> K[in-memory drum kit, compiled for level matching] --> R[collection.adg]
```

## Definition of Done

Applies: 1 specs `features/daw/collection-folder.feature`; 2 Rust (`apricity-data` collection read, `apricity-daw`, `apricity-cli`); no Python; 3 no schema change (the contract is untouched; if the Collection rename lands first, its contract change is that task's, not this one's); 4 CLI `--collection`, help, located errors; 5 temp libraries built in tests, no audio; 6 `design/curation.md` and `design/daw-presets.md` sections; 7 docs/tools.md, glossary ("Collection" if still missing); 8 a `web` need; 9 `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-data -p apricity-daw -p apricity-cli` and a manual check in the DAW; 10 running log; 11 `feat(<task id>)`, not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M1 (the rack writer, apricitus-109615) and M3 (the clip folder writer, apricitus-f7e8f5).
